Restless? Yeah, definitely. I mean, especially if I'm stuck sitting somewhere. If someone was standing right over my shoulder? Hmm, honestly, I think I'd still mess it up. Like I said, that's really what brings me in—I just keep making these dumb mistakes on the sales reports. He plays pickleball like every single day. I guess pickleball is huge down there. He tried to explain the rules to me over Thanksgiving, but it just sounds like giant ping-pong. He actually tore his meniscus playing last month. Had to get surgery and everything. They gave him this crazy brace that looks like something out of Terminator...

Wait, sorry. The reports. Yeah, even with someone watching, I still make those same dumb mistakes, like copying the wrong numbers or missing steps. It's just really frustrating.
